answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring economic collateral to validate transactions, ensuring the network does not sink to a nadir of trust. By staking tokens—the nectar that fuels agent participation—an attacker must lock significant capital to acquire influence. The cost of a Sybil attack becomes prohibitively expensive, as the malicious actor would have to control enough supply to shift the network landscape like a dune in a gale, effectively pricing out fabrication.
